name: Halma plc
tagline: Growing a safer, cleaner, healthier future for everyone, every day
hero_kpi_rationale: KPI clé Halma : groupe industriel UK décentralisé acquisitif, profit ajusté progresse de manière constante depuis 22 ans consécutifs (record FTSE 100).

kpis.description_fr: Profit avant impôt ajusté FY24 422 M£, +18%. 22 ans de croissance consécutive (record FTSE).
kpis.description_en: FY24 adjusted PBT £422M, +18%. 22 consecutive years of growth (FTSE record).

kpis.description_fr: Revenus FY24 2,25 Mds £, +9%. Mix organique + acquisitions.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus Safety FY24 1,04 Mds £. Cœur Halma : sécurité industrielle, incendie.
kpis.description_en: FY24 Safety segment revenue £1.04B. Halma core: industrial safety, fire.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the Safety Segment segment.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus Environmental FY24 604 M£. Eau, qualité air, analyse.
kpis.description_en: FY24 Environmental segment revenue £604M. Water, air quality, analytics.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the Environmental Segment segment.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus Healthcare FY24 607 M£, +11%. Dispositifs médicaux, diagnostic.
kpis.description_en: FY24 Healthcare segment revenue £607M, +11%. Medical devices, diagnostics.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the Healthcare Segment segment.
